_readme: This file is a TEMPLATE for .claude/settings.json. After setup: (1) Create a .claude/ directory inside your vault folder, (2) Copy this file to .claude/settings.json, (3) Replace each [UUID] placeholder with the actual UUID from your Claude installation. Find UUIDs by running 'claude' and checking available tools, or by looking in ~/.claude/mcp.json. The pattern is: mcp__[UUID]__[tool_name]. You can also build this allowlist organically: run the pipeline and choose 'Always allow' at each prompt — it will be added to .claude/settings.local.json automatically.
_instructions: To create .claude/settings.json: mkdir -p .claude && cp claude-settings-template.json .claude/settings.json — then edit .claude/settings.json to replace placeholders.
